title: Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.10304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems. We introduce Longtail-SWE, a benchmark of 202 issue-resolution tasks across 13 languages with limited coverage in existing repository-level benchmarks: Clojure, Dart, Elixir, Erlang, F#, Haskell, Julia, Kotlin, Lua, OCaml, R, Scala, and Swift. Its construction uses a solver-judge-repairer pipeline: a solver attempts each candidate task, and a judge reviews the task together with the solver's trajectory and test results to guide revisions to tests and task descriptions. translated_title: Longtail-SWE：面向小众编程语言的高质量软件工程任务
translated_abstract: 对于许多编程语言生态系统而言，具有挑战性的仓库级基准仍然稀缺，在这些生态系统中，由于候选任务数量稀少，筛选时若任务描述模糊或测试存在缺陷，往往会丢弃有价值的工程问题。我们提出了Longtail-SWE，一个包含202个问题解决（issue-resolution）任务的基准，涵盖13种在现有仓库级基准中覆盖有限的语言：Clojure、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、F#、Haskell、Julia、Kotlin、Lua、OCaml、R、Scala和Swift。其构建采用求解器-裁判-修复器（solver-judge-repairer）流水线：求解器尝试每个候选任务，裁判则结合求解器的执行轨迹和测试结果对任务进行审查，以指导对测试和任务描述的修订。这些修订旨在纠正那些拒绝有效替代实现或接受错误解法的测试，同时保留具有挑战性的任务并保持其预期的需求。我们评估了九种模型配置，包括前沿（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: Longtail-SWE是一个涵盖13种小众编程语言的202个仓库级问题解决任务基准，通过求解器-裁判-修复器流水线自动审查并修正有缺陷的测试与任务描述，为现有基准覆盖不足的语言生态系统提供了高质量的软件工程评测资源。
en_tdlr: Longtail-SWE is a benchmark of 202 repository-level issue-resolution tasks across 13 underrepresented programming languages, constructed via a solver-judge-repairer pipeline that reviews and repairs defective tests and ambiguous task descriptions, delivering high-quality SWE evaluation for longtail language ecosystems.
